The '''''Sark-I''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] deliberately crashed the ''Sark-I'' into an Imperial [[palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weerden]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] the vessel's crew and caused an explosion that claimed the life of the Imperial [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin]].
